name: golf-tracker
comment: No dependencies and no build step — this file exists only to document the two commands. The app is plain ES modules served as static files. Serving MUST go through tools/devserver.py: python -m http.server sends no cache headers, the browser then caches modules heuristically, and a test run can pass against code that has already been deleted. That happened — see commit 8be9c30.

scripts.test: echo "Serve the repo, then open http://localhost:8123/test/ — the suite runs in the browser against the shipped modules. See test/README.md."
